title: Uniform tensor-product arrow comparison for a fixed affine triple
statement: Let $S,X_0,Y_0$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with structure maps $x:X_0\to S$ and $y:Y_0\to S$, and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ satisfy $y\circ f_0=x$ and be locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $W\subset S$, $V\subset Y_0$, $U\subset X_0$ be affine opens with $V\subset y^{-1}(W)$ and $U\subset f_0^{-1}(V)$. Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $e_0:W\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$ an isomorphism. There exist commutative $R$-algebras $B,C$ and a finitely presented $R$-algebra homomorphism $\varphi:B\to C$ such that the following holds for every scheme $T$, morphism $t:T\to S$, commutative $R$-algebra $A$, and isomorphism $e:t^{-1}(W)\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$ with $e_0\circ(t^{-1}(W)\to W)=\operatorname{Spec}(R\to A)\circ e$. Form the base changes $X_T,Y_T,f_T$ using fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $U_T,V_T$ be the inverse images of $U,V$ under their projections. There is a morphism $g:U_T\to V_T$ with $\iota_{V_T}\circ g=f_T\circ\iota_{U_T}$ and an isomorphism in the arrow category between $g$ and $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi):\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R C)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R B)$. An arrow isomorphism means a pair of scheme isomorphisms on source and target making the square commute. This conclusion is uniform in $T,A,e$, with one fixed $B,C,\varphi$.

proof.text: Take B=Γ(Y₀,V) and C=Γ(X₀,U). Use Spec.preimage of hW.isoSpec.inv≫e0.hom to obtain R→Γ(S,W), compose with Y₀.hom.appLE to give B its R-algebra structure, and compose further with f₀.left.appLE to give C its structure. This last appLE is definitionally an R-algebra homomorphism. finitePresentation_appLE proves it finitely presented. Naturality of the open toSpecΓ and cancellation of the open inclusions prove the spectrum compatibility squares.

Apply the projection-compatible base-change chart theorem to Y₀,V and X₀,U, with the same R,A,e. Derive U⊆X₀⁻¹(W) from the two original inclusions and the Over morphism equation. Define g by resLE of the base-changed morphism; its factorization equality is resLE_comp_ι.

Use the two chart isomorphisms to form Arrow.isoMk'. Cancel their inverses and the target-chart inclusion, and use pullback.hom_ext. For the Z projection, tensor-map composition with includeRight is induced by φ and SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec gives the original chart-map square. For the T projection, tensor-map composition with includeLeft is unchanged. The projection equations of the chart isomorphisms finish both goals.

theorem exists_affineChart_tensorComparison
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (X₀ Y₀ : Over S) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left]
    (W : S.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (V : Y₀.left.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (eV : V ≤ Y₀.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (U : X₀.left.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (eU : U ≤ f₀.left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (e0 : W.toScheme ≅ Spec R) :
    ∃ (B C : CommRingCat.{u}) (aB : Algebra R B) (aC : Algebra R C),
      letI := aB
      letI := aC
      ∃ φ : B →ₐ[R] C, φ.FinitePresentation ∧
        ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ S) (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (aA : Algebra R A),
          letI := aA
          ∀ (e : (t ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ≅ Spec A),
            t.resLE W _ le_rfl ≫ e0.hom =
              e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) →
            ∃ g : ((pullback.fst X₀.hom t) ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ⟶
                ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom t) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
              g ≫ ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom t) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι =
                ((pullback.fst X₀.hom t) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫
                  ((Over.pullback t).map f₀).left ∧
              Nonempty (Arrow.mk g ≅ Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R A) φ).toRingHom)))
